title: $L^2$-contraction and asymptotic stability of Cahn-Hilliard fronts
summary: We study the stability of transition fronts for the one-dimensional Cahn-Hilliard equation. More precisely, we prove that for any Hölder initial datum sufficiently close to a front in the $L^2$ norm, the corresponding solution of the Cahn-Hilliard equation exists globally and converges, up to a dynamical shift, to the front as time tends to infinity. The result holds for a class of double-well potentials in a $C^4$-neighborhood of the standard quartic potential.
